subject: AcreetionOS Update — June 14, 2026
body:
Our continuous integration pipeline just got a significant boost with the introduction of per-pipeline staging directories, which will help avoid publish races between concurrent builds, and relative symlinks for the latest ISO images, ensuring they resolve correctly on the host web root. This improvement is a crucial step towards making our release process more reliable and efficient, and you can read more about the details of this change on our changelog page at https://acreetionos.org/changelog.html.

Development
The development team has been working tirelessly to refine our pipeline, and these latest changes are a testament to their hard work. With these improvements in place, we can expect a more streamlined release process, which will ultimately benefit our users. For more information on our development process and how you can get involved, visit our wiki page at https://acreetionos.org/wiki.html.

Community
The community has been actively discussing the latest security updates, including the recent Emacs 31.1 release and Sunday's stable kernel set. We encourage all users to stay up-to-date with the latest security patches and updates, which can be found on our documentation page at https://acreetionos.org/docs.html. Additionally, our flash page at https://acreetionos.org/flash.html provides a quick overview of the latest news and updates. 

Tip of the day
If you're looking for ways to stay current with the latest developments in AcreetionOS, we recommend checking out our changelog page regularly, where you can find detailed information on all the latest changes and updates. You can also visit our main website at https://acreetionos.org/ to learn more about our project and how you can get involved.
